name: application-sidebar-layout-shell
title: Sidebar Layout Shell
description: A full app-frame layout — fixed sidebar with nav and user footer, a topbar with breadcrumb and search, and a scrollable content area.
useWhen: Scaffolding a new authenticated app view — this is the outer frame that every page renders inside.
You need a starting point combining sidebar nav, a topbar, and a scrollable main region rather than assembling `dashboard-sidebar` and a header separately each time.
avoidWhen: You only need the sidebar navigation itself, not the full page frame — use `dashboard-sidebar` or `side-menu` directly.
The app is a single-page tool without persistent navigation — a full shell adds structural overhead a simpler layout doesn't need.
responsiveBehavior: The sidebar is a fixed width column beside a flex-1 content area; collapse the sidebar to an icon-only rail or an off-canvas drawer below the width needed for its full nav labels.
accessibility: The sidebar's nav items list uses a real <nav> landmark, distinct from the <main> content region and <header> topbar.
The active nav item is marked by both a background/text color change and should carry aria-current="page" in a real implementation.
The topbar's search and avatar controls are keyboard-reachable in document order before the main content.

variants.title: App shell
variants.description: A fixed sidebar (logo, four nav items with Dashboard active, user footer) beside a topbar (breadcrumb, search, avatar) and a scrollable content grid.
accessibility: Sidebar navigation is wrapped in a <nav> landmark separate from the <main> content region.

variants.title: App shell (Dark)
variants.description: Sidebar layout shell adapted for dark surfaces, including the active-nav-item highlight and topbar borders.
accessibility: Sidebar, topbar, and content borders all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark page background.
